item: row 264: a request that meets a store switch is refused with its words, not a 500
summary: LaneSwapping (an open that waited past SWAP_WAIT_S during a store's switch) now answers a route with 409 and the fixed SWAPPING_WORDS, no traceback; a background job whose failure is or was raised from it records exactly those words and logs one line (from None opts out); callers that catch it themselves are unchanged. Release line: If a page or background task tries to read a separate store while it is being switched for its rebuilt copy, it now says so and asks you to try again, instead of reporting an internal error.
